description:
One Skin Lab item with every skin it can be viewed in, in 3D. The item as in /skin-lab/items plus `skins`: every skin with 3D textures, most expensive first, each with
`itemdefid`, `name`, `price` (USD cents, Steam lowest listing; null = not on the market), `icon`, its own
`viewer_url` and wiki `page`. Guns also carry `attachments` (what they accept - see /skin-lab/attachments). Every skin of one item that can be viewed in 3D, each with its own viewer_url and price (USD cents).
name: skinlab_get_item
title: One Skin Lab item with every skin it can be viewed in, in 3D
